idea: Give each node a colour so that neighbours never share one, using as few colours as possible. Try 2 colours, then 3 and so on; colour the nodes one by one and, when a node has no colour left, go back and change an earlier choice.
useWhen: Scheduling: exams, classes or tasks that must not clash
Assigning frequencies or registers so neighbours differ
avoidWhen: The graph is large and you must be certain of the fewest colours: it can take very long
A quick answer that is good enough is fine (a greedy colouring is much faster)
